objective: Gate 1 R4 final de Catalogo Ampliado / Gobierno Corporativo. Reejecutar exclusivamente la auditoria SQL canonica despues del hardening R8 que preserva checks[].sql_evidence. Determinar con evidencia publicada que objetos reales existen para empresas, personas, usuarios, clientes, proveedores, contactos, documentos, roles, tareas y notificaciones, incluyendo Gobierno_* si existe. El resultado debe permitir decidir el DDL minimo legitimo sin duplicar fuentes de verdad. No modificar SQL, repositorio, Worker infra ni Produccion.
acceptance: sql_readonly_evidence presente y con evidencia estructurada de todas las consultas
evidencia suficiente para clasificar REUTILIZAR/EXTENDER/CREAR/DESCARTAR y definir DDL minimo legitimo
constraints: no crear ni alterar tablas, columnas, indices o constraints
no insertar, actualizar ni borrar datos
no duplicar empresas, personas, usuarios, clientes, proveedores, contactos, documentos, roles, tareas ni notificaciones
no tocar Supervisor, watchdog, launcher ni owner del Universal Worker

queries.name: schema_inventory_compact
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,t.name AS table_name FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name='Sistema_Empresas' OR t.name LIKE 'Gobierno[_]%' OR t.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name LIKE '%Tarea%' OR t.name LIKE '%Notificacion%') ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: schema_columns_keys_relations
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,CASE WHEN pk.column_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_pk FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ic.column_id FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id WHERE i.object_id=t.object_id AND i.is_primary_key=1 AND ic.column_id=c.column_id) pk WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name='Sistema_Empresas' OR t.name LIKE 'Gobierno[_]%' OR t.name IN ('Tareas_Inventario','Operativo_Notificaciones_Log') OR t.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id

queries.name: unique_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique,c.name AS column_name,ic.key_ordinal FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.indexes i ON i.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND i.is_hypothetical=0 AND (i.is_primary_key=1 OR i.is_unique=1) AND (t.name='Sistema_Empresas' OR t.name LIKE 'Gobierno[_]%' OR t.name IN ('Tareas_Inventario','Operativo_Notificaciones_Log') OR t.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%') ORDER BY t.name,i.name,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: foreign_keys
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_NAME(fkc.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id)='Sistema_Empresas' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE 'Gobierno[_]%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) IN ('Tareas_Inventario','Operativo_Notificaciones_Log') OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Persona%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Usuario%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Cliente%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Contacto%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Documento%' OR OBJECT_NAME(fkc.parent_object_id) LIKE '%Rol%' ORDER BY parent_table,fk_name,parent_column

queries.name: canonical_identity_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,SUM(CASE WHEN c.name IN ('PersonaID','UsuarioID','ClienteID','ProveedorID','EmpresaID','RFC','CURP','Email','Correo','Nombre','RazonSocial','ContactoID','DocumentoID','RolID') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identity_signal_columns,COUNT(*) AS total_columns FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=t.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id WHERE s.name='dbo' AND (t.name LIKE '%Persona%' OR t.name LIKE '%Usuario%' OR t.name LIKE '%Cliente%' OR t.name LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR t.name LIKE '%Contacto%' OR t.name LIKE '%Documento%' OR t.name LIKE '%Rol%' OR t.name='Sistema_Empresas') GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY identity_signal_columns DESC,t.name

queries.name: task_notification_contract
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=t.object_id JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE t.name IN ('Tareas_Inventario','Operativo_Notificaciones_Log') ORDER BY t.name,c.column_id
